payload.instruction: Make a star catching game on the island. Bright yellow stars drift slowly down from the sky over the island, spinning as they fall. I move a basket left and right along the front of the island to catch them, with W A S D or the arrow keys on a laptop and the thumbstick in VR, and I can also point at a falling star and press to catch it. Each star I catch bursts into confetti and adds one to the score sign, and a rainbow star is worth five. Put the game's name, Star Catcher, on its card with one line on how to play.
